Type.evidence_source: The goal of the interviews was to understand the day-to-day experiences of tribal members, their perceptions or beliefs related to suicide, and their suggestions for community-specific efforts to address suicide. A semistructured interview protocol was selected to enable flexibility in the order and phrasing of questions (Merriam, 2009). Sample questions included, "What are traditional core values for your family?" and "What do you think are the reasons for the increase in suicide in the Cowichan community?"
